sections.heading: About
sections.text: My name is Edward, but you can also call me Katz! I have been cosplaying since 2023 and I still have lots to learn. My main hobby is drawing, though. And I also ship myself with Knockout from Transformers.

sections.heading: Availability
sections.text: I usually go to cosplay events and conventions once every 2 months. My main spots are Metro Indah Mall, Cihampelas Walk, or anywhere in Bandung that isn't too far from my house or too much of a hassle, really.

sections.heading: Costumes
sections.text: My current main costume is Starscream from Transformers, specifically his design from the G1 cartoon. You might also see me dressed up as The Medic from Team Fortress 2 or Purple from the Among Us show.
